# mcrl metadata

[Command reference](README.md)

Manage metadata of hosts, services and roles.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`metadata delete`](#mcrl-metadata-delete) | Delete a metadata value |
| [`metadata get`](#mcrl-metadata-get) | Show a metadata value |
| [`metadata list`](#mcrl-metadata-list) | List metadata namespaces |
| [`metadata set`](#mcrl-metadata-set) | Create or replace a metadata value |

## mcrl metadata delete

Delete a metadata value.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl metadata delete <namespace> (--host <host> | --service <service> | --role <service:role>) [flags]

Aliases:
  delete, rm

Delete a metadata value.

API: DELETE /api/v0/{hosts/<id>,services/<name>,services/<name>/roles/<role>}/metadata/<namespace>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl metadata delete inventory --host web-1
  mcrl metadata delete deploy --service web --yes

Flags:
      --host string      host (ID, name or cid:<custom identifier>)
      --role string      role as <service>:<role>
      --service string   service name
```

## mcrl metadata get

Show a metadata value.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl metadata get <namespace> (--host <host> | --service <service> | --role <service:role>) [flags]

Show a metadata value: the JSON stored under the namespace, as is.

API: GET /api/v0/{hosts/<id>,services/<name>,services/<name>/roles/<role>}/metadata/<namespace>
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl metadata get inventory --host web-1
  mcrl metadata get deploy --service web --jq .version

Flags:
      --host string      host (ID, name or cid:<custom identifier>)
      --role string      role as <service>:<role>
      --service string   service name
```

## mcrl metadata list

List metadata namespaces.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl metadata list (--host <host> | --service <service> | --role <service:role>) [flags]

Aliases:
  list, ls

List the metadata namespaces of a host, service or role as [{"namespace": ...}].

API: GET /api/v0/{hosts/<id>,services/<name>,services/<name>/roles/<role>}/metadata
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl metadata list --host web-1
  mcrl metadata list --role web:app --jq '.[].namespace'

Flags:
      --host string      host (ID, name or cid:<custom identifier>)
      --role string      role as <service>:<role>
      --service string   service name
```

## mcrl metadata set

Create or replace a metadata value.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl metadata set <namespace> -f <file> (--host <host> | --service <service> | --role <service:role>) [flags]

Create or replace a metadata value with any JSON (or YAML) value up to 100KB.
Limits: 50 namespaces per host or service, 10 per role.

API: PUT /api/v0/{hosts/<id>,services/<name>,services/<name>/roles/<role>}/metadata/<namespace>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl metadata set inventory --host web-1 -f inventory.json
  echo '{"version": "1.2.3"}' | mcrl metadata set deploy --service web -f -

Flags:
  -f, --file string      JSON or YAML file ("-" for stdin) (required)
      --host string      host (ID, name or cid:<custom identifier>)
      --no-refetch       print the API response ({"success": true}) instead of fetching the updated resource
      --role string      role as <service>:<role>
      --service string   service name
```
